data.name: Sharvankaar
data.gender_notes: Sharvankaar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharvankaar is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' meaning 'God of Power' and 'Kaar' meaning 'Doer'. This name signifies a powerful and strong individual who is capable of protecting and providing for themselves and their loved ones. The name Sharvankaar carries the meaning “God of Strength and Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvankaar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of strength and power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvankaar is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and spirituality. It is believed that those named Sharvankaar are blessed with the divine power and strength of the gods, and are able to use this power to overcome challenges and protect those around them.
data.etymology: Sharvankaar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Strength and Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvankaar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
